independence_declaration.statement: I (domain-reviewer) wrote no implementation in the reviewed scope. transformation-analyst wrote the analysis, register, coverage files, glossary, field inventory, journeys, permissions matrix, acceptance map and stage plan. delivery-orchestrator wrote the agent definitions, runner, write guard, gate tooling, extraction scripts and delivery records. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-18 review record. I read only my own round-17 record and evidence, to reuse its script as a regression check. I wrote only review evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/round-18/ and this record. I executed code only in a disposable clone under my private $TMPDIR, which I removed afterwards.

It touches only the round-18 assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json, which are all D-005 metadata. candidate.mjs prints sha256:21efe44b6a4613a004b27282e66db59d42254903e5e2c6e2d0a8398a5e023cc5 in both the working tree and the clone at 450c756f. (b) Parse every w:tbl into rows and cells and compare it, cell by cell, with the matching table block in playbook.blocks.json.
checks_run.environment: Python 3.11 in the Bash sandbox; disposable clone
checks_run.expected: The docx SHA-256 is 2584a352…548ad2. The token sequences are identical apart from markup artefacts. All 49 tables match cell for cell.
checks_run.actual: sha256 2584a35282804e639a697478eae75a55a43cfb8c551345dfc7636b9b34548ad2. There are 3584 docx tokens and 3583 md tokens (ratio 0.99986), with one non-equal opcode: the literal '|' in 'Version 1.0  |  September 2026' (B0005). playbook.md line 21 contains that '|', but my markdown stripper removes every '|', so this is an artefact of my checker and not an extraction gap. There are 49 docx tables and 49 table blocks, and 0 tables have a cell mismatch. As a regression, the round-17 segment script also reports 1028 segments, 0 missing and 0 extra (DOM18-04).

checks_run.procedure: Items 3 and 4. The item groups are: 6 governance roles, 6 phases, G1–G6 questions and evidence, 14 charter fields, thesis, 5 scope checks, outcome hierarchy, 10 TOM dimensions and questions, 10 canvas panels and prompts, 90–120 minute workshop, 10 business-case sections, OS layers and cadences, 6 lifecycle steps, 7 adoption indicators, 90-day windows, Day-90 test, 25 questions, 4 bands, roaming elements and traceability rows, modes, T11 decisions and SLAs, RACI deliverables, wave rows, T10 areas and RAG logic, source table and custom extensions. Then read the rows REQ-PB-012/029/030/031/041/042/048/053/060/071/086/087/090/091/092.
checks_run.command: python3 docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/round-18/r18-deliverables-check.py $TMPDIR/review-r18; python3 heredoc printing the key REQ-PB rows (13-deliverable-rows.log)
checks_run.environment: Python 3.11 in the Bash sandbox; disposable clone
checks_run.expected: Every source item is present, and every deliverable is fully specified with testable acceptance.
checks_run.actual: 31 of 33 item groups matched verbatim with 0 missing, including all 25 health-check questions, all 4 band texts, the 20 wave cells, the 6 T10 RAG rules, the 15 roaming traceability cells and the 14 charter fields. The script exits 1 on two groups, and only because of its strict whole-string rule. The thesis (REQ-PB-030) is stored as its four structured parts and rendered as the source sentence. The custom extensions (REQ-PB-002) are listed item by item, with acceptance tied to B0158–B0162. I checked both by hand and found no dropped substance; the follow-up note is appended to the log. The arithmetic in the acceptance criteria is correct: T06 scores 5,4,3,2,1 give 3.30, and the attach example 0.10→0.12 × 100,000 × 50 SAR gives 100,000 SAR. Health-check Yes=1/No=0 scoring is labelled as implementation assumption D-010.

summary: PASS, no findings, on candidate sha256:21efe44b…023cc5 (commit 450c756f). The domain scope hasn't changed since round 17 (only the D-032 sandbox repair and its decision entry changed), but I re-reviewed it in full. Extraction fidelity passes on a new, independent check: a word-token diff of the whole docx body against playbook.md, plus a cell-by-cell comparison of all 49 tables. All 165 B blocks and 423 M blocks have consistent dispositions, and the non-requirement rationales are true. The T01–T16 and charter columns, the value lists, the weights, the waves, the T11 SLAs and the T10 RAG logic are verbatim. Every first-class deliverable is fully specified, with its items verbatim or, for the thesis and the custom extensions, structurally complete. The operating-logic rules are stated with testable acceptances. Provenance is honest. A new 67-block master-prompt sample (seed 1818) is correct. Staging follows §21. The glossary, journeys and permissions are sound. prefreeze passes in a fresh clone. No engineering or business approval is granted by this review.
